content.text: Rory McIlroy from Holywood is considered one of the favorites for The Open, while Shane Lowry from Ireland aims to secure a victory in Portrush, similar to his triumph in 2019 when the championship last took place in the coastal town.
Over the next few days, Portrush is anticipated to welcome more than 275,000 spectators, which will make it the largest sporting event ever held in Northern Ireland.
